note: The TinyZKP Guard organization subscription is withdrawn and is no longer sold at any price. This is a business decision, not a launch-gate state, which is why it is recorded here rather than derived from GuardLaunchEvidenceV2: no amount of passing launch evidence should ever put Guard back on sale without deliberately revoking this file.
why_a_separate_state: `closed` and `frozen` both mean 'not selling right now' and render as schema.org/OutOfStock, which tells Google and every other machine reader the product is coming back. A withdrawn SKU is schema.org/Discontinued. Before this record existed the commercial data model had no way to express the difference, so the withdrawal landed only in human-readable HTML while pricing.json, commerce.json, offers.jsonld, and llms.txt all still described a purchasable product.

surviving_obligations.note: Withdrawal ends new sales. It does not cancel commitments already made to anyone who bought while it was on sale.
surviving_obligations.why_price_policy_is_retained: site/commerce.json and site/pricing.json keep `price_policy` intact as the historical record of those obligations. It is deliberately NOT deleted: the numbers are evidence of what was promised, and scripts/commercial/render_offers.py validates them. What changed is that no surface presents them as a current offer.
